text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein leaves for London on a private visit.
- Iraqi ambassador says Aqaba port will be treated as an Iraqi port for his country's import needs.
- Bank of Rural Development plans to enter the investment field for the first time.
- Supply Ministry declares a "state of emergency" to control increasing prices.
- Release of 10 detainees arrested (for alleged involvement in bread riots) in the Tafila governate.
- International interest in the Amman-Zarqa metro link project.
- Government denies plan for fuel price hike, calls rumours unfounded.
- A national plan being considered to increase wheat production to reduce Jordan's food import bill.
- Rules announced to regulate vegetable and fruit exports.
